No OHLC parsing function in parse.rs module
WebSocket bar streaming commented as not implemented in Python data.py

recommendations: subscribe_book and subscribe_trades are fully functional and production-ready
Orderbook delta parsing is complete with proper sequence tracking and BookAction determination
Trade tick parsing is complete with aggressor side detection and RFC3339 timestamp parsing
Consider implementing OHLC bar parsing in parse.rs to enable WebSocket bar streaming
Consider implementing checksum validation for orderbook integrity (checksum field exists in KrakenWsBookData)
All core subscription/unsubscription methods have comprehensive test coverage
Python integration layer properly delegates to Rust implementation

subscribe_book.functionality: Converts InstrumentId to Ustr symbol, calls subscribe with KrakenWsChannel::Book and optional depth parameter

subscribe_trades.functionality: Converts InstrumentId to Ustr symbol, calls subscribe with KrakenWsChannel::Trade

parse_book_deltas.functionality: Parses KrakenWsBookData into Vec<OrderBookDelta>, handles both bids and asks, determines BookAction (Update/Delete) based on qty==0, generates sequence numbers, parses RFC3339 timestamps

parse_trade_tick.functionality: Parses KrakenWsTradeData into TradeTick, maps KrakenOrderSide to AggressorSide, parses RFC3339 timestamps, validates price and quantity with instrument precision

handle_book_message.functionality: Processes WebSocket book messages, accumulates deltas across multiple data items, wraps in OrderBookDeltas, increments book_sequence counter

handle_trade_message.functionality: Processes WebSocket trade messages, accumulates trades across multiple data items, returns as NautilusWsMessage::Data

notes: The Kraken WebSocket implementation is robust and production-ready for orderbook deltas and trade ticks. Both subscribe_book and subscribe_trades methods exist, are fully functional, and have comprehensive test coverage. The parsing layer correctly handles Kraken's WebSocket v2 API message formats, including snapshot and update types for orderbooks, and multiple trades per message. The main gap is OHLC/bar parsing, which is acknowledged in the code comments. The Python integration layer in data.py properly delegates to the Rust implementation via PyO3 bindings.
